title: Zero Gravity: The 47G Summit
summary: Zero Gravity Summit equips the builders, operators, and leaders advancing national security technology with the networks, resources, and programs they need to accelerate innovation and defend what matters.
body_markdown:
Zero Gravity Summit equips the builders, operators, and leaders advancing national security technology with the networks, resources, and programs they need to accelerate innovation and defend what matters.


**Join 3D Systems industry experts at Zero Gravity Summit to discuss how we can provide tailored solutions for your most challenging applications.**


***3D Systems is Transforming Manufacturing for a Better Future*** with our end-to-end solutions. Each application-specific solution comprising materials, hardware, software, and services, is powered by the expertise and passion of our employees who help companies innovate, design, and manufacture in new ways – enabling them to realize competitive advantage.
